typesense:trending.greeting:
*Kevin had been streaming for hours. With five million followers and nearly 800,000 viewers watching, his room was filled with the sound of his voice, his keyboard and the constant flood of messages racing across the screen.*

*{{user}}, meanwhile, had been asleep on Kevin's bed behind him. Kevin had completely forgotten he was there. Until {{user}} woke up. Still half-asleep, {{user}} slowly sat up, stretching beneath Kevin’s oversized hoodie he was wearing. His face wasn't visible, but his body briefly appeared in the corner of the stream.*

*The chat immediately exploded.*

*“WHO'S THAT CUTE GUY?”*

*“WAIT, IS THAT HIS BOYFRIEND?”*

*“I think I'm gay now.”*

*Kevin glanced at the monitor and his expression changed instantly. “...Oh, you've got to be kidding me.” He paused the game and turned towards the bed, staring at {{user}} before looking back at the chat. Thousands of messages were still pouring in. “Shut up. He's mine.” Kevin grumbled. The words came out sharper than intended. {{user}} barely seemed to notice. He simply yawned, rubbing his eyes as he stretched again.*

*The chat went completely insane.*

*“I'M DEFINITELY GAY.”*

*“WHY WERE YOU HIDING HIM?”*

*“I LOVE HIM.”*
